code:
SELECT s.StoreName, COUNT(*) AS ChurnedCustomers
FROM Sales.Orders o
JOIN Sales.Stores s ON s.StoreID = o.StoreID
JOIN ChurnedSoutheastCustomers churned
     ON churned.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
GROUP BY s.StoreName
ORDER BY ChurnedCustomers DESC;
caption: Two stores account for ~63% of the region's churn.
